name: Rhode Island Anime Con
blurb: An anime, voice-actor and cosplay weekend at the Rhode Island Convention Center from the Rhode Island Comic Con organizers.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'June 12-13, 2027 * RI Convention Center'; countdown widget targets June 12. Footer: '(c) 2026 Rhode Island Anime Con - Altered Reality Entertainment'.

notes: Sister event to Rhode Island Comic Con, same organizer (Altered Reality Entertainment) and venue, but its own site/domain (rianimecon.com) rather than ricomiccon.com. The 2027-06-12/13 edition is the next one listed; the celebrities page explicitly says 'Celebrity guest announcements coming soon', so guests is none-yet. The site's photo grids on the guests/celebrities pages are all sponsor logos, not guest photos.
